ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white/light-grey mottled regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottled patch on the distal left lobe; distinct series of vertical white and dark linear bands on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression, approximately 45 degrees, partially obscured by water turbulence at the baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with non-uniform peaks and valleys; extreme high-frequency protrusions visible on the distal tips caused by clustered surface matter.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to narrow, elongated points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, circular high-contrast clusters localized on the extreme far-left and far-right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical, parallel-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the lateral portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) on the distal tips and widespread vertical rake mark scarring across the visible ventral surface.
